what_happened.line: The outgoing DPW director presented the FY23 budget, with the snow account running well over its appropriation and the budget level-funded.
Members debated the Flat Hill Road drainage design appropriation, and one questioned whether the design fixes the source of the problem; no resolution was reached.
A tractor and brush mower capital request was questioned on its financial case; the director cited a crossover of roughly six years against outsourcing.
The chair will confer with the town manager by Monday on how to take up Flat Hill Road drainage further.
No budget vote was taken; the only vote recorded was to adjourn.

why_it_matters: The drainage design and mower requests are capital items that could reach Town Meeting as warrant articles, so residents may be asked to vote on them.
Snow spending running past its appropriation is a mechanism that can draw on other funds and raise pressure on the FY23 tax levy.
watch_next: The chair's follow-up with the town manager on Flat Hill Road drainage, due by the Monday after this meeting.
The Finance Committee's warrant letter, which the committee planned at this meeting.
